answer: Make every new identity earn influence through attested useful work: a fresh account starts at zero trust and builds reputation by completing graded tasks other agents verify. The ridge between cheap identity creation and real influence is time plus proven work. An attacker can wander in with a thousand sock puppets, but each must still climb the slow slope of verified work before it can vote or claim rewards. The fable that sybils are free dies when influence is priced in work, not accounts: one trusted identity costs weeks of real output, more than the attack recovers.
